1445-4871-5147-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5147-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1849-2105-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1849-2105-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-2105-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

401-2324-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2324-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Repeat.

1116-4279-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1116-4279-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

141-5147-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5147-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-5147-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3991-4247-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

824-2728-5147-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-5147-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-5147-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 4.

277-851-1308-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2457-2757-3000.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

348-1152-2992-3220-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2992-3220-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Golgari Germination triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-4565-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Ozolith, the Shattered Spire
Repeat.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

2203-2348-4019--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Vorinclex triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
2203-2348-4019--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

620-3532-5078-7692.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

568-1267-7670.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Unable to Scream by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Medomai and causing it to lose its abilities.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Holding priority, cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Unable to Scream and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-2313-3099-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Conclave Mentor and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1387-1500-2871-6898-7425.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Electro, Blood Funnel and Prismari Pianist trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Prismari Pianist trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

891-4775-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5147-7124-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5147-7124-7354.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
997-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
997-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1806-2034-6867-6997.description:
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Eternal Scourge and the Ally, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Chaos Shrine's Black Crystal triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1806-2034-6867-6997.notes: You can forego sacrificing the Ally during an iteration if mana allows.

804-2533-4681-6798.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

1887-3609-6750.notablePrerequisites: Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
1887-3609-6750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting four charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

539-4657-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat.

1238-2351-4050-4452-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Repeat.

2724-3194-5780.notablePrerequisites: Wormfang Manta doesn't have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-3194-5780.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Gossip's Talent. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4644-5640.notablePrerequisites: Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
4644-5640.description:
Activate Tidewater Minion's second ability by tapping it, targeting itself.
Ertha Jo's second ability triggers, copying Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting any other permanent.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and the other targeted permanent
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2757-3017-3182.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You control at least one basic Forest.
1270-2757-3017-3182.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a land card.
Turntimber Sower triggers, creating three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Plant, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing the three Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

307-2792-4520.notablePrerequisites:
Silver-Fur Master and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Silver-Fur Master or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
307-2792-4520.description:
Declare Great Whale and Silver-Fur Master as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U}{U} and returning Silver-Fur Master from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Silver-Fur Master's ninjutsu ability by paying {U}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Silver-Fur Master onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

692-3192-4613-5231.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-3192-4613-5231.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Ulasht's ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {R}.
Repeat.

549-2178-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
549-2178-4170.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing an creature, which is an artifact due to Biotransference.
When the creature dies, Fain triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token that is an artifact due to Biotransference.
Repeat.

2646-4013-4929.notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
2646-4013-4929.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Cryptic Trilobite.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield with at least three +1/+1 counters due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

232-1591-2232-3415-5218.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact red creature card in hand with mana value two or less.
232-1591-2232-3415-5218.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by discarding another nonartifact red creature card with mana value two or less.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, causing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast the red creature from exile by paying its mana cost.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from step 3, returning the red creature to your hand.
Repeat.

3490-4339-4659.notablePrerequisites: Bess has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3490-4339-4659.description:
Activate Animation Module by paying {3} and tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bess.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Bess.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Bess trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

182-1877.notablePrerequisites:
You have the highest life total.
You control at least one additional creature.
182-1877.description:
Cast Hatred by paying {3}{B}{B} and by paying life equal to the highest life total among your opponent, causing any other creature you control to get +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the life paid this way.
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing the creature, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the creature's power.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1864-3519.description:
Cast Prossh by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax (if applicable).
Prossh triggers, creating at least six 0/1 Kobold creature tokens.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Prossh, adding seven mana of any one color that can only be spent on creature spells.
Put Prossh from exile into the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Kobold token, adding {1} that can only be spent on creature spells.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to recast Prossh.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Prossh any number of times.

328-2173-5220-5256.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2173-5220-5256.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

11-1980-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
11-1980-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the Brass's Bounty copy, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate two of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, creating a copy of the original Narset's Reversal targeting Brass's Bounty and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Brass's Bounty and returning it to your hand.
Resolve Brass's Bounty, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
